title: Gandalf: Flash Shall Not Die! Increasing Flash Storage Lifetime for KV Cache Offloading in LLM Serving
abstract: arXiv:2610.30791v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: KV caching reduces the serving cost of large language models (LLMs), but the growing KV cache footprint is increasingly exceeds GPU and host-memory capacity. Therefore, people use SSD to expand the KV cache storage capacity with high I/O bandwidth. However, in production LLM workload, such as multi-round conversation and LLM agents, the total amount of KV cache writes significantly exceeds SSD capacity, shortening SSD lifetime from years to months. To improve SSD lifetime, a natural solution is to reduce the KV cache writes by gating the KV cache writes via historical access patterns. However, that significantly lowers the KV cache hit rate (and increase the LLM serving cost) since KV caches from different attention types might have identical historical access pattern but different future access patterns. tldr: 提出Gandalf系统，通过结合访问模式等信息智能门控KV缓存写入闪存，在不降低KV缓存命中率的前提下，显著延长LLM服务中作为KV缓存卸载介质的SSD使用寿命。
en_tdlr: Gandalf extends SSD lifetime for KV cache offloading in LLM serving by gating KV cache writes based on access patterns while preserving KV cache hit rate.
